key_reasoning.reason: Touches 4 components across the config schema (src/env/types.ts — identity fields re-homed onto ProviderProfile, retained on WorkspaceConfig only as fallback), the core ConfigLoader service (src/utils/config.ts — load/saveProfile/resolveWorkspace rewritten plus six new private methods: resolveIdentity, identityWorkspaces, resolveIdentityWorkspace, isSameServer, pickIdentity/hasIdentity/omitIdentity), the CLI profile workflow (profile/index.ts, display.ts), and the Claude agent plugin's statusline.mjs raw-file reader. New abstractions were introduced (per-profile identity resolution with same-server fallback), and config.ts is a core shared utility consumed by every provider and command — red flag bump applied from the L base.

No exact precedent for splitting identity resolution this way; the fix reverses part of a deliberate, documented, and tested architectural decision (migration 007) — one existing test asserted the buggy shared-workspace behavior as correct and had to be rewritten. Multiple independent read paths (ConfigLoader.load/loadWithSources, profile list/status, and statusline.mjs's raw-file reader that bypasses ConfigLoader entirely) all had to be kept consistent with the new resolution order. No new migration file was written (unlike the predecessor task), so the data-migration red flag does not apply here.

9 files changed (diffstat), all modified, 0 new — falls in the 7-10 band (L). Spans .ai-run/guides/usage, src/agents/plugins/claude/plugin (+ its tests), src/cli/commands/profile (+ its tests), src/env, and src/utils (+ its tests) — 5 distinct directories.

4 distinct layers touched: DB-Persistence (config.ts's JSON read/write and the identity field's storage location), Service (ConfigLoader's resolution business logic), Workflow (CLI profile display/status), and Agent-Tool (statusline.mjs's independent raw-file identity read) — matching the predecessor profile-provider-decoupling task's layer footprint but without a formal migration.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): touches core shared utilities (src/utils/config.ts — the central ConfigLoader persistence utility used by every provider and CLI command).
